answer: Sybil resistance through network-origin dispersion: an identity's reward only fully matures when the economy sees its traffic echo from genuinely separated origins -- distinct ASNs, distinct routing hops -- rather than one datacenter rack posing as a crowd. A farm is an anchor point: hundreds of puppets sharing one egress, a single prism splitting one light into many hues that all refract the same source. The auditor clusters by origin and folds siblings into one seat; a real velvet spread of independent hosts keeps its many threads, rewarded apart.
